source_execution: 10 frames, 4096 initial tile state/time pairs, 203 changed pairs. Native reconstructs and compares all 4096 pairs before/after actual finish_frame plus source erosion RNG and both stored shader clocks. Actual original GameMap/MapSystem/THREE run with constant supplied performance timestamp per stage, inert input/collision and image I/O adapter. Relative game time is independently supplied.
changes: Map::new_at/set_state store raised/transition timestamps in float32, matching source InstancedBufferAttribute. Existing new() remains controlled time zero.
Runtime uses monotonic wall/performance namespace for tile creation/erosion timestamps, separate from reset-on-start game clock used by projectile/effects.
Hex and obstacle shader times initialize zero and update at Map stage after rendering; rendering deformations/tone use stored clocks.

Tile fade travels through float UV attribute; tree fade through float normal.w tag -3 before source .1 alpha cutoff. Removes byte alpha rounding without changing base texture filters or creating a pipeline.
Frozen reference capture imports performance/shader times from its known exporter sequence (two updates at 6000 then explicit render). Diagnostic built, not run.
limits: No GPU/browser/window/input check. GLSL fade/deformation/tone, float-vs-driver transcendental precision, clipping/coverage and pixels are not established by JS state oracle.
Native wall is a logical monotonic scene clock; complete document loading/background/host-pause timing, source absolute-origin alignment and within-frame performance getter timing remain unverified.
MapSystem fixture restart is reconstruction at supplied performance time; whole Game/host/clock lifecycle traced separately.
Alpha-attribute corrections are source-derived, not GPU-verified; full reported texture clarity and whole-mode/site parity remain unfinished.
